But you cannot build a functioning group on private margins. The group's margin is everyone's margin or it belongs to nobody. Take the food back into the communal supply. Document it in the inventory. You documented everything in that notebook. Resource burn rates, decision quality, weather conditions. All of it accurate, all of it useful. But the flowers are the thing that doesn't appear in the notebook and can't, because what they were measuring isn't a variable you had a column for.
